name: Collado de Contreras (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, green, white and red in the proportions 1/4, 1/12, 1/3, 1/12 and 1/4.
history: The inauguration and adoption of the arms and flag by the municipal council was formalised in a public act on 27 May 1996 in the parish church; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/4, 1/12, 1/3, 1/12 and 1/4, red at the edges, white between and green at the centre.
